'''Monkeys''' were creatures of a [[Primate/Legends|simian]] nature. Examples included the [[beek-monkey]], [[Cophrigin monkey]], [[Geniserian sand monkey]], [[Kowakian monkey-lizard/Legends|Kowakian monkey-lizard]], [[rat-monkey]].
